landmarks.noteZh: 馆方把省长公署旧址描述在今鼓楼以东及东北一带。图中标记鼓楼。
landmarks.noteEn: The museum places the former compound east and northeast of today’s Drum Tower. The pin marks the tower.

landmarks.noteZh: 馆方记载当年立碑处在新城大楼东北侧。图中采用今新城广场照片的拍摄位置，供辨认街区。
landmarks.noteEn: The museum records the stone northeast of the Xincheng building. A photograph’s camera location at Xincheng Square identifies the neighbourhood.

landmarks.noteZh: 馆方记载石碑于 1948 年迁入西安碑林。图中标记今天的博物馆，旧日安放位置未详。
landmarks.noteEn: The stone entered the Xi’an Beilin in 1948. The pin marks today’s museum. The historical position within the grounds is unknown.
